title: Make Maruchan Ramen Noodle Soup
summary: Cook a packet of Maruchan chicken ramen: get the packet and a bowl, boil water, cook the noodles, stir in the seasoning, and serve.

nodes.name: Get ramen packet from drawer
nodes.instruction_novice: Open the drawer and take out one packet of ramen noodle soup.
nodes.end_state: The person is holding a Maruchan ramen packet.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get ramen packet from drawer?

nodes.name: Read package directions
nodes.instruction_novice: Flip the packet over and read the cooking directions on the back.
nodes.end_state: The back of the packet with the directions is facing the camera.

checks.question: Is this step done: Read package directions?

nodes.name: Get a bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Take a bowl from the counter that is big enough for soup.
nodes.end_state: A bowl is in hand or set near the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get a bowl?

nodes.name: Boil two cups of water
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour about two cups of water into a small pot, set it on the stove, and turn the burner to high until the water boils.
nodes.end_state: A pot of water is boiling rapidly on the burner.

checks.question: Is this step done: Boil two cups of water?

nodes.name: Open packet and remove seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Tear open the packet and set the small seasoning packet aside.
nodes.end_state: The noodle block is out of the wrapper and the seasoning packet sits on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Open packet and remove seasoning?

nodes.name: Add noodles to boiling water
nodes.instruction_novice: Gently place the noodle block into the boiling water so it doesn't splash.
nodes.end_state: The noodle block is in the boiling water in the pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add noodles to boiling water?

nodes.name: Cook noodles three minutes, stirring
nodes.instruction_novice: Let the noodles cook for about three minutes, stirring now and then to break them apart.
nodes.end_state: The noodles are soft, separated, and loose in the pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook noodles three minutes, stirring?

nodes.name: Turn off heat, add seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn off the burner, then empty the seasoning packet into the pot and stir well.
nodes.end_state: The burner is off and the broth in the pot is golden with the seasoning mixed in.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off heat, add seasoning?

nodes.name: Pour soup into bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Carefully pour the noodles and broth into the bowl. Use an oven mitt if the pot handle is hot.
nodes.end_state: The bowl is filled with noodles and broth and the pot is empty.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pour soup into bowl?

nodes.name: Clean up and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Throw the wrapper in the trash and put the pot in the sink, then enjoy your soup.
nodes.end_state: The bowl of ramen sits ready with a utensil and the wrapper is in the trash.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean up and serve?
